description: Search plans currently paying PBGC premiums — active pension plans (NOT terminated/trusteed), single-employer or multiemployer. Returns plan name, sponsor, admin city/state, EIN, plan effective date, and participant count. Answers "pension plans sponsored by Delta Air Lines", "multiemployer plans paying PBGC premiums in New York", "how many participants in the Acme Corp pension plan". Example: pbgc_search_premium_filers({ sponsor: "Delta Air Lines" }); pbgc_search_premium_filers({ state: "NY", plan_type: "multiemployer", limit: 25 }). Keyless.

state.description: Two-letter US state code of the plan administrator
